summary: Iteration 8 — Backend geocoding overhaul verified (10/10 pytest PASS in 2.29s). (1) All 5 abbreviated SP addresses (Avenida Paulista 1578, R Augusta 500, Al Santos 100, Trav Padre Manoel de Nóbrega 50, Praça da Sé) resolved via provider='google' with location_type ∈ {ROOFTOP, RANGE_INTERPOLATED, GEOMETRIC_CENTER} and coords inside São Paulo state bounds. (2) 'Brasil' country-level query is correctly rejected by geocode_google (APPROXIMATE filter) — POST returned either fallback provider or found=false; test verified provider != 'google'. (3) 10-address batch completed in <4.5s (Semaphore=5 + sleep=0.1) — verified numerically AND by static inspection at server.py:966 (Semaphore(5)) and :976 (asyncio.sleep(0.1)). Old values (Semaphore(2)/sleep(0.4)) confirmed absent. NOTE: contract mentioned lines 866/876, actual location is 966/976 — no functional difference. (4) _expand_address_abbrev() defined at server.py:206, contains all 6 required substitutions (R→Rua, Av→Avenida, Al→Alameda, Trav→Travessa, Dr→Doutor, Prof→Professor) plus bonuses (Avda, Tv, Pça/Pca, Dra, Profa, Eng, Cel, Mal, Jd). Called from clean_address() at line 256, BEFORE the ', São Paulo, SP' city-context append at line 263 — verified with index ordering assertion. (5) geocode_nominatim() pipeline order confirmed: geocode_google() (line 734) → geocode_mapbox() (line 739, with relevance<0.75 rejection at line 654) → try_nominatim() (line 771) → geocode_photon() (line 786). (6) Regression /api/optimize with 4 SP stops (schema uses fields id:int, codigo, endereco, lat, lon) returned 200. (7) Regression /api/parse-file without file returned 422. FRONTEND STATIC CHECK (upload.tsx): isPdf = name.endsWith('.pdf') || mime === 'application/pdf' at line 53-54; processStops called with {preserveOrder: isPdf} at line 62; manual path uses {preserveOrder: false} at line 75; CIRCUIT_KEY = 'rota_circuit_mode' set to '1' or '0' via storage.setItem at line 98; router.replace('/scanner') for preserveOrder=true at line 107, router.replace('/route') otherwise at line 110. All branch logic matches spec. MINOR OBSERVATION: geocode_mapbox/geocode_photon/try_nominatim return dicts WITHOUT a 'provider' key — only geocode_google sets provider='google'. Not blocking (test only asserts provider=='google' for the 5-address happy path, and provider!='google' for the Brasil rejection), but future maintenance would benefit from all providers tagging their output.

minor.issue: geocode_mapbox() / geocode_photon() / try_nominatim() return payloads do not include a 'provider' key — only geocode_google() sets provider='google'. Downstream code cannot tell which fallback served a result. Consider adding provider='mapbox'/'nominatim'/'photon' in each fallback return.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:569-616 — geocode_google() correctly uses region=br, components=country:BR, language=pt-BR and filters location_type ∈ {ROOFTOP, RANGE_INTERPOLATED, GEOMETRIC_CENTER}. Returns provider='google' + location_type in payload. Iterates all results, not just first, to skip APPROXIMATE matches — good.
server.py:619-671 — geocode_mapbox() enforces relevance>=0.75 (line 654) and applies São Paulo bbox + proximity + 0.7-degree distance safety check. Good defence-in-depth.

server.py:727-796 — geocode_nominatim() pipeline order matches spec: Google → Mapbox → Nominatim (full) → Nominatim (simplified) → Photon (full) → Photon (simplified). The 0.3s sleep between two Nominatim attempts is polite.
server.py:206-232 — _expand_address_abbrev() uses IGNORECASE regexes with \b word-boundary + trailing \s+ to avoid mangling 'Travessia', 'Ruay', etc. Good.
server.py:960-980 — geocode_batch() Semaphore(5) + sleep(0.1) — 10-address batch resolved in ~1s in practice (verified). Cache dict prevents duplicate lookups within a single request.

server.py:661 — Mapbox result rejected if abs(lat + 23.55) > 0.7 or abs(lon + 46.63) > 0.7. This is ~78km — reasonable for SP metro but would reject legitimate SP state addresses far from the capital (e.g., Campinas at ~90km). Not in scope but flagging for future.
upload.tsx:50-63 — Elegant PDF-vs-Excel branching using both filename extension AND MIME type as a defence against wrong mime detection. Correct.
upload.tsx:98 — CIRCUIT_KEY storage set BEFORE saveRoute — good ordering; scanner reads it on mount without race.
upload.tsx:74-75 — Manual paste path explicitly passes {preserveOrder: false} so it goes to /route — consistent with 'user pasted their own order, let them optimize on the map' comment.
